title: UC major affiliations: campus -> school/college -> major -> degree
description: Which school or college offers each undergraduate major at the UC TAG campuses, from the campuses' own catalogs and admissions pages. The TAG matrix excludes some majors by school or college (every major in UC Irvine's Donald Bren School of Information and Computer Sciences; UC Santa Barbara's College of Creative Studies and College of Engineering) and sets some minimum GPAs by college or school; the TAG engine joins this file with it to decide those rules. It holds no TAG rules itself.
notes: Campus ids are the TAG matrix's campus ids.
An organization's `name` is its official name; `aliases` are other official spellings or abbreviations, and the TAG matrix's spelling where it differs, each with its source.

A major name listed under two organizations of one campus (e.g. UC Santa Barbara Mathematics, in Letters and Science and in Creative Studies) resolves to both: rules that hold for one only need review.

`unresolved` lists majors whose school/college the sources don't settle (e.g. majors run jointly by two schools). A major not listed at all is unknown too. Neither is ever read as "not in an excluded unit".
`degrees` lists the bachelor's degrees the source prints; empty means the source doesn't state them.
UC Santa Cruz is not included: no TAG rule refers to a UC Santa Cruz school, college or division.
